claims.evidence: Subjective term; quality cannot be assessed from photos alone.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the date stamp on the handle or the inspection plate.

risks.risk: The burner may be clogged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the burner ignited and producing a steady flame.

risks.risk: The valve may be damaged or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the valve assembly and a video of it being opened and closed.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the date stamp on the handle or the inspection plate.
Video of the burner being lit and burning.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
